sources: https://reserveohio.com/OhioCampWeb/#!park/106 (ReserveOhio API ohiordr.usedirect.com: place 106, grids 514-517 and search/details for every unit, 2027-06-15; sampled units on 2027-06-19, 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12; read 2026-10-30)

values.note: $27 a night for a non-electric site (the Class B area, about five miles from the main campground); electric $41; full hookups $56; the same on a Saturday (June 2027). Off-peak (November 2026, January 2027) non-electric $23, electric and full-hookup $37 (full-hookup sites have no water then). The ten tent-only sites are $31. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio's prices read 2026-10-30.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details for all Mohican campsites, 2027-06-15 (Campsite Non-Electric 27.00, Electric 41.00, Full Hookup 56.00, Tent Only 31.00); units B-10, 001 and 027 on Sat 2027-06-19 (27.00 / 41.00 / 56.00), 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12 (23.00 / 37.00 / 37.00), Fee 6.50, read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: ReserveOhio search/details (electric and full-hookup sites list Electricity Hookup '50'; the 48 full-hookup sites list water and sewer hookups) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/mohican-state-park-campground ('100 electric, 51 full hook-up, and 33 non-electric sites'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 160 web-bookable RV sites: 98 electric (pads 35-61 ft, 13 pull-throughs) and 48 full hookup (38-56 ft, 15 pull-throughs) in the Class A campground, and 14 non-electric RV sites (B-10 to B-23) in the primitive Class B area about five miles away. Its other nine sites and the ten tent-only sites are not RV sites. ODNR counts 100 electric, 51 full-hookup and 33 non-electric sites. Up to two pets per site.

sites.source: ReserveOhio search/grid 514-516 + search/details (IsRVSite, Pad Length, PullInTypeName; Class B description 'approximately five miles from the main campground') + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/mohican-state-park-campground ('100 electric, 51 full hook-up, and 33 non-electric sites', 'Up to two pets are allowed on each site'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Class A campground. Swimming pool (Memorial Day to Labor Day), playground, nature center. The Class B area has non-flush toilets and no showers; its campers may use Class A's. Off-peak (mid-November to March 31) showerhouse 1 and pit latrine 1 stay open, and water is available at the dump station.

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/mohican-state-park-campground ('Showers, flush toilets, dump station, and a campground store'; 'Off-peak Season ... Water is available at the dump station. Showerhouse 1 is open, as is pit latrine 1') + ReserveOhio Class B site description ('primitive with non-flush toilets, no showers'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 'Reservations may be made up to six months in advance online or by calling (866) 644-6727.' 14-night maximum on ReserveOhio. Off-peak, Class A sites 46-64, 86-108 and 133-153 stay open all winter, and Class B sites 1-23 until the first Monday after the second gun season closes in mid-December. No driving through the campground for visitors Memorial Day to Labor Day.

booking.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/mohican-state-park-campground (quoted; 'visitors are not permitted to drive through the campground from Memorial Day through Labor Day') + ReserveOhio search/details (AllowWebBooking true, MaxStay 14), read 2026-10-30

note:
Sites are out in the open, but the park is worth seeing.

Split candidate (feedback_split_multi_campground_parks): 'Mohican Campground 2' is a separate primitive Class B area 'approximately five miles from the main campground' (sites at about 40.611,-82.306 to 40.612,-82.312, 3.5-4 km west of the pin), with its own toilets and no showers; 14 of its 23 sites are RV sites at $27. The entry's pin and stored $27 base mix the two campgrounds: Class A alone would be $41 (electric) base.
